statements.impact_statement: CVE-2023-45913 reports a NULL pointer dereference in dri2GetGlxDrawableFromXDrawableId() in Mesa's GLX client code, reached when the X server sends a DRI2_BufferSwapComplete event to an application that is using DRI3: the function dereferenced the DRI2 per-display data, which is not allocated under DRI3 (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/issues/9856, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-45913). The published mesa package ships Mesa's GLX client library as libGLX_mesa.so.0 in libglx-mesa0, built from Mesa 25.0.7 with the Debian 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 changes. That dereference is not in Mesa 25.0.7: upstream commit f79eb4730cd28871d136ab57865b165ce949d070 (glx: move dri2Hash to base glx_display, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/merge_requests/30375), first in Mesa 24.3, removed the per-display DRI2 structure from this function. In src/glx/dri2_glx.c of Mesa 25.0.7 it looks the drawable up in the GLX display's dri2Hash, which is left unset when no DRI2 screen is created, and __glxHashLookup() in src/glx/glxhash.c returns without dereferencing anything when the table is unset.
